name: ALAGAD SMP SEASON 2
description:
★ A GROWING COMMUNITY • JAVA + BEDROCK ★

Economy Survival • MMORPG • Parkour • SMP • PvP

Alagad SMP is your ultimate destination for a dynamic, community-driven Minecraft experience. Whether you want to amass wealth, embark on epic adventures, or simply build alongside friends, our network brings together a perfect blend of classic gameplay and customized progression.

Whether you want to dominate the market in Economy Survival, level up your skills in our MMORPG world, speedrun Parkour maps, battle it out in PvP, or relax in our classic SMP, there’s always a new goal to conquer.

◆ ECONOMY SURVIVAL

Build your fortune in a deeply integrated, player-driven world. Claim your land, establish thriving shops, trade with others, and rise to the top as one of the server's wealthiest players.

◆ MMORPG

Step into a sprawling adventure packed with custom quests, dynamic leveling systems, skill trees, and challenging boss fights. Forge your own legend, loot dungeons, and unlock custom gear.

◆ SMP

The classic Minecraft multiplayer experience at its best. Join a tight-knit community, collaborate on massive town builds, and survive the elements in a welcoming, grief-free environment.

◆ PARKOUR

Test your agility across a huge variety of custom maps. Race against the clock, beat your personal bests, and climb the leaderboards on courses ranging from beginner-friendly to expertly brutal.

◆ PVP

Prove your combat prowess in fast-paced arenas. Jump into intense duels, team battles, and competitive leaderboards with balanced mechanics and a dedicated anticheat.

◆ MORE THAN JUST GAMEMODES

✦ Cross-Realm Economy — Your hustle matters. Earn currency and rank up to unlock unique perks and cosmetics that show off your dedication.

✦ Active Community — A welcoming player base with dedicated staff ensuring a smooth, toxic-free environment for everyone.
